# Repository guidance

## Documentation

- Keep a useful `README.md` in every non-ignored repository directory, including
  the root, hidden folders and new nested directories. Do not add README files
  under `.github` or `examples`, including their subdirectories. Git's `.git` metadata and
  ignored directories are excluded. Link guides to their parent or index and
  keep them reachable from the project README.
- Explain actual flows, ownership and important invariants, not just filenames.
  Prefer concise Mermaid diagrams to long prose when a diagram clarifies the
  relationships; retain short text for limits, errors and non-obvious details.
  Verify diagrams and local links, and update affected guides when behavior changes.
- In `src`, document functions and locally exported values with JSDoc and use
  `@param`, `@returns`, `@throws` and `@type` when applicable. Imports and
  re-exports from other files do not need duplicate documentation. Separate
  JSDoc sections with one blank comment line and place the comment directly
  above its declaration.
- Keep imports at the top, consecutive with no blank lines between them, and
  leave one blank line after the last import. See
  `test/features/performance.feature` for the enforced source rules.

## Repository layout

- [src](../src/README.md): implementation, organized by responsibility.
- [test](../test/README.md): Cucumber features, steps, fixtures and hooks.
- [build](../build/README.md): bundle, development server, data and release tooling.
- [dist](../dist/README.md): generated, tracked main and worker bundles; change
  `src/` and rebuild.
- [examples](../examples/): demo pages; [data](../examples/data/)
  contains their archives and data.
- [libs](../libs/README.md): demo loader, optional lens and OpenLayers bindings;
  the minified bindings are generated by the build.
- `.github/`: Copilot guidance and the
  [CI](./workflows/ci.yml) and [CD](./workflows/cd.yml) workflows.

## Tests

- Follow `test/README.md` and the existing Cucumber features, steps and
  fixtures. Prefer targeted scenarios and keep external requests deterministic.
- Scenario setup and steps share a 30-second budget; split independent checks
  rather than raising timeouts. Cleanup and global hooks are exempt.
- Cucumber merges CLI feature paths with its configured defaults. Use `--name`
  for focused runs, and run the README presence scenarios when adding directories.
- Follow `build/README.md` when changing build, development, data-generation or
  release tooling.
